ticket.subject: Permission problem for a team lead
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

I'm the IT lead at Kettlewick Ltd. We gave one of our team leads the Manager role, and they still get a 'no permission' message when opening Reports.

We tried removing and adding the role again.

Not urgent at all. Please tell us what we are missing.

Regards,
Fatima

label_notes: clean access (access-role-permission): a role problem for one user with others unaffected is P3; urgency low: no time pressure.
